additional_info.subject: RE: ID0378990-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002836] FailsafeMode CRM:00921001105
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope this email finds you well.
Could you please perform the following steps:
Perform a hard reset on the charger.
Check the connection on the 24V DC bridge terminal to ensure it is not causing any power supply issues to SECC.
Verify that the router's Ethernet port or Ethernet switch port is not loose.
Inspect for any loose connections to the OCPP router and the LAN cable of the router.
Connect with MobaXterm and check for device scans to identify any devices that are not responding.
Reasons for the continues reboot and subsequent entering of FailsafeMode could be:
one of the FW components (PLC, Router, SECC, ...) is not reachable
RJ45 connector not properly connected on one of the devices
PLC not reachable (e.g. CFastCard corrupted) (Note: this would not notify FailsafeMode in the Error-Flags, since the PLC is not working in this case)
any software service failing to start.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0378990-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002836] FailsafeMode CRM:00921001105
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Sascha,
I hope you're doing well.
We have reviewed the logs on SCB and found the following error:
ecog-secc-adapter/c8a17f15d125[700]: Error polling coap://10.20.17.100:5683/state Error: No reply in 4.25s.
Given the IP
10.20.17.100
, we recommend bringing a spare SECC2300 (KF11) and an Ethernet cable, as this may resolve the issue. However, if the issue persists, there might be a potential problem with the Cfast, which could require flashing.
For the Cfast flashing, please ensure all necessary files are available during the activity, such as the configuration file, live Linux, and any other relevant files.
Note
: I will be on rotational leave today. If you have any other queries, we suggest you forward this ticket to the L2 queue with your specific query, and someone from NOC will address and respond.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav Malokar
